ngaru_bon.summary: Internal transport through the deep gorges. Dangerous but necessary

ngaru_bon.title: ecology.domesticates.ngaru_bon
ngaru_bon.summary: Hlonqa [PROP] (Bos taurus africanus, Sanga-type cattle of the Nguni lineage). Lateral fricative hl- onset and prenasalized palatal click nq- in second syllable — both diagnostic Ngaru-Bon sounds in one word. Noun-class plural: iziHlonqa (many cattle), uHlonqa (a single named beast).

ngaru_bon.title: ecology.encounters.ngaru_bon
ngaru_bon.summary: Dawn on the second day out finds the caravan already moving. The plateau air is cold and mist hangs blue in the shadow-pools beneath the kopjes, those piled granite whalebacks. A pair of southern ground hornbills (Bucorvus leadbeateri) is booming in duet somewhere east, the deep ooomph... ooomph... oo-oo carrying four or five kilometres over the wet grass, answered by a Swainson's francolin (Pternistis swainsonii) go…

ngaru_bon.title: ecology.biome.ngaru_bon
ngaru_bon.summary: Southern African miombo-savanna highveld with Ethiopian-style grain farming on cooler uplands.

ngaru_bon.title: factions.civ.ngaru_bon
ngaru_bon.summary: Ngaru-Bon is "Monolithic" in the typology of magic/06, the only Veydrian civ at this position on the Schism Axis. A single guild — the ancestor-smith federation of click-and-lateral-trained lineages — controls every household that addresses infants in Gyamsgra click-speech, every forge that produces consecrated metal, every shrine that certifies the genealogical binding of consecrated weapons to their lineages. Refor…

ngaru_bon.title: factions.crisis.metal_interdict
ngaru_bon.summary: The Metal Interdict is the continental cold war that began when a Ngaru-Bon ancestor-smith council, following a disputed plateau-kingdom succession, imposed a formal forge-strike on arms-shipments to a specific Kheshkai client accused of desecrating an ancestor-shrine. The substrate of the crisis — the religious mechanism by which the strike has come to extend to caravan-lord allies who never touched Ngaru-Bon soil,…

ngaru_bon.title: factions.worked_example.field_notebook_ngaru_bon_market_day
ngaru_bon.summary: A worked example in the ethnographic-fieldnote-style observation form. The notebook entry is preserved among the working-papers an Apprentice Cohort certification candidate retains for his certification dossier. The candidate is a Tongue-Guild apprentice on observation rotation at the Ngaru-Bon plateau market venues; observation rotation is a standing certification requirement in the Kheshkai-Ngaru-Bon ritual-metallu…

ngaru_bon.title: magic.system.ngaru_bon_gyamsgra
ngaru_bon.summary: Etymology: gyam (forge) + sgra (sound, voice). "Forge-voice" — the ancestor-smith guild's sacred register, and the most institutionally monolithic register on the continent.

ngaru_bon.title: religion.institution.ngaru_bon_smith_guild
ngaru_bon.summary: Legitimize by constraint. The guild controls both ritual and military production. Their Investiture-Controversy-style interdict is a forge-strike -- refusing to produce weapons or reconsecrate tools. Great Zimbabwe's dzimbahwe logic: rainmaker kings depend on ancestor-sanctioned regalia that the guild makes.

ngaru_bon.title: religion.sacred_register.ngaru_bon_clicks
ngaru_bon.summary: Ngaru-Bon practitioners hold that their click-and-lateral chants enter the iron at the forge. Clicks are the hardest cross-linguistic acquisition in the real world, which is why Ngaru-Bon must start training in infancy (parents deliberately use click-speech to infants) and why this register is the hardest in Veydria to fake or leak. The guild is simultaneously religious institution, labor union, and military chokehol…

ngaru_bon.title: Lapam-tier — forge-ancestor industrial chants
ngaru_bon.summary: Forge-register vocabulary employs ejective stops [-p'-, -t'-, -k'-] as root-internal markers absent from both vernacular and pastoral-register speech. These ejectives mark words as belonging to Lapam's industrial-ancestor domain. The glottalic airstream mechanism (ejective production) is physically demanding during sustained forge-work, contributing to the register's embodied cost

irrah.title: Irrah Drylands
irrah.summary: Southeastern coast → overland caravan → Basin ports. Independent of Basin politics

irrah.title: ecology.domesticates.irrah
irrah.summary: rahab (Camelus dromedarius, dromedary pack camel; plural ruhub) and arwat (aristocratic riding breed). Names preserved verbatim — no alteration, no alternative proposed.

irrah.title: ecology.encounters.design_philosophy
irrah.summary: Every biome has a distinct triptych: - First sound (hornbill duet, fish-eagle yelp, muezzin-analog, rooster across a lagoon) - Peak-sun hazard (heat shimmer, reef glare, altitude UV, reg-gravel that eats shoe-leather) - Night-presence (wolves, leopards, karakurt, horned viper, corsair-galleys, malarial quays)

irrah.title: ecology.encounters.irrah
irrah.summary: Before the muezzin-analog has finished the dawn call from the mud-brick minaret of the oasis, the Qeturin is already out past the last date palms (Phoenix dactylifera), crouched on the reg, letting a handful of gravel sift through his fingers into the wind. He is reading the grain-drift — the faint striae that every wind-reader knows. He tastes the air for the metallic dryness that foretells qibli, the harmattan-anal…

irrah.title: ecology.biome.irrah
irrah.summary: Saharan-Arabian hyper-arid desert with scattered oases and wadi drainages.

irrah.title: factions.civ.garamantes_shadow_ruin_coordination
irrah.summary: The four refuge-eligible Garamantes-shadow ruin-sites named at geography/locations/garamantes-shadow-ruins.md are continental waypoints whose continued operation rests on two institutional facts the factions/01_civ_factions/irrah.md per-civ file presupposes without anchoring: the Imajīn Caravan Council books the routes and underwrites the maintenance from its dust-tithe pool, and the Northern Qalībin Azmarāʔ path-fin…

irrah.title: factions.civ.irrah
irrah.summary: Irrah is the only Veydrian civ that is not reducible to a single institutional type per magic/06. The Qalībin scholarly order contains three sub-registers, each with a distinct institutional character: Ṣāliqūn (the oath-binders, Type 2 "Institutionalized with reform" — the active Naturalist Schism sits here); Qeturīn (institutional consensus, where traditionalist and naturalist readings converge on outcomes and the S…

irrah.title: factions.crisis.calendar_schism
irrah.summary: The Calendar Schism is the continental cold war that began when two senior Qollari calendar-keeper lineages produced divergent intercalation calculations for the current cycle, with the result that every date between winter solstice and spring equinox is correct under one lineage's reckoning and void under the other's. Cinchona advance-purchase contracts, mountain-pass corridor-access timings, oath-validity windows,…

irrah.title: factions.crisis.harbor_oath_war
irrah.summary: The Harbor-Oath War is the continental cold war over commercial-oath jurisdiction in Aethelian Basin port cities. It is not a military conflict and has produced no military casualties; it has produced bribery, forum-shopping, competing witness-clerks, sustained pamphleteer-and-counter-pamphleteer warfare, and a single documented assassination two generations back whose recurrence has been a continuing institutional a…

irrah.title: magic.system.irrah_qalib
irrah.summary: Etymology: from the triliteral root √q-l-b ("to turn, to pour"). "The mould" — the base sacred register of the Qalībin order, with three institutionally-distinct sub-registers: Ṣāliqūn (oath-binders), Qeturīn (wind-readers), and Azmarāʔ (star-readers).

irrah.title: Azmarāʔ — star-readers and path-finders
irrah.summary: The ritualist must deliver the formula in a single unbroken breath. A cough, stutter, or mispronunciation voids the ritual and is actively dangerous

kheshkai.title: Kheshkai Steppes

kheshkai.title: ecology.domesticates.kheshkai
kheshkai.summary: Tokhan [PROP] (Equus ferus caballus, Mongolian-type landrace). Back-harmony vowels u and a, voiced uvular fricative gh, final nasal n typical of Kheshkai animate nouns. Plural: turghat (collective suffix).

kheshkai.title: ecology.encounters.kheshkai
kheshkai.summary: The first light over the Kheshkai Steppe is not light but cold — a blue, breath-stinging cold that bites even in the Grass Moon of high summer. You wake inside the felt tent to the bitter sweetness of dung smoke — argal, dried sheep and horse pats layered into the central iron stove — and the sour-milk damp of the airag skin swinging from the door-frame, punched by every passer-by to keep it churning. The felt walls,…

kheshkai.title: factions.civ.kheshkai
kheshkai.summary: Kheshkai is "Non-institutional" in the typology of magic/06, the only Veydrian civ at this position on the Schism Axis. There are no colleges, no guilds, no lineages in the formal sense; master-shamans take one to three apprentices over a five-to-ten-year horseback apprenticeship; identification is by the hearing-gift, a phonological capacity detectable in childhood. Orthodoxy does not survive a master's death unmedi…

The substrate of the crisis — the religious mechanism by which the strike has come to extend to caravan-lord allies who never touched Ngaru-Bon soil,…

kheshkai.title: magic.system.kheshkai_varkosh
kheshkai.summary: Etymology: var (oath, promise) + kosh (wind). "Oath-wind" — the sacred register of the Kheshkai steppe-peoples.

kheshkai.title: religion.institution.kheshkai_shamans
kheshkai.summary: Legitimize but cannot constrain. Their confederation-consensus structure means when a khan wins, the argument ends; when he loses, shamans switch sides. They set up no permanent institutions. They travel with caravans, witness on the move, collect fees, vanish.

kheshkai.title: religion.sacred_register.kheshkai_harmony
kheshkai.summary: Kheshkai shamans use vowel-harmony as a binding grammar: an oath in perfect harmony binds; a broken-harmony oath is a non-oath, hearable-but-ineffectual. The system is oral-only (no scribal class), master-to-apprentice on horseback, and identified by "hearing-gift" (often perfect-pitch individuals). Each generation renegotiates orthodoxy.

kheshkai.title: religion.reform.kheshkai_single_sky
kheshkai.summary: A charismatic shaman -- Tegu Bokh (PROPOSAL) -- preaching that there is ONE sky and therefore ONE correct liturgy, and the confederation's polyvocal practice is degeneration. This ignites only under ecological trigger (a bad-grass decade, a horse-plague read as divine judgment on shamanistic disunity).

ndjadi.title: ecology.domesticates.ndjadi
ndjadi.summary: Ndowu [PROP] (Bubalus bubalis, water buffalo — swamp type). Prenasalized nd- onset, round back vowel o, open u final. Tone: low-high (ndo-wu). Plural: bandowu by class-prefix.

ndjadi.title: ecology.encounters.ndjadi
ndjadi.summary: Day One — Tidal delta. The dhow leaves saltwater on the ebb, its lateen sail slack in the dead air before dawn. Mist lifts from the brown water in sheets, and the first cry of a fish eagle (Haliaeetus vocifer) — that rising, yelping whistle, thrown back and forth between perches — announces the sun. The smell is wet silt, rotting mangrove, woodsmoke from fishing hamlets where women split catfish (Clarias gariepinus)…

ndjadi.title: ecology.biome.ndjadi
ndjadi.summary: Seasonally flooding tropical river delta. Composite Inner Niger + lower Nile + Gangetic.

ndjadi.title: factions.civ.ndjadi
ndjadi.summary: Ndjadi is "Institutionalized with reform" in the typology of magic/06, and its position on the Schism Axis is the Open and active one — the Vernacular-Habal Movement is named, organized, currently publishing, and recognized as a faction even by the elder colleges that condemn it. The literate scribal infrastructure of the imperial colleges, the habal copy-service traditions in the delta trading ports, and the river-c…

ndjadi.title: magic.system.ndjadi_wazahaki
ndjadi.summary: Etymology: waza (skill) + haki (truth, justice). "Craft of truth" — the sacred register of the Ndjadi scribal colleges.

ndjadi.title: religion.institution.ndjadi_scribes
ndjadi.summary: The people who certify correct speech. Since correct speech IS prayer, the scribes who control certification hold a functional veto over any public act that requires liturgical authorization. They are notaries, priests, and cosmological regulators in one institution.

ndjadi.title: religion.sacred_register.ndjadi_tier_prefixes
ndjadi.summary: Ndjadi magic is the strongest Vedic analog in Veydria: speaking correctly IS prayer, a misapplied prefix is not a grammar error but a cosmological miscategorization with consequences. The three-tier prefix system (ra-/ka-/nga-) simultaneously classifies cosmological rank, determines liturgical validity, and gates institutional authority.

ndjadi.title: religion.reform.ndjadi_vernacular_habal
ndjadi.summary: Habal copy-service scribes producing vernacular-glossed sacred-prefix editions. The scribal-cosmological priesthood condemns this as "if nga- is explained, it ceases to do its cosmological work." Pamphlet circulation bypasses senior interpretive authority.

ndjadi.title: religion.conflict.ndjadi_scribal_imperialism
ndjadi.summary: A faction of Ndjadi scribes argues that because their register grammaticalizes cosmological tier, it is the only complete magical language and all others are fragmentary. The claim cannot be refuted inside Ndjadi's terms and cannot be answered in any other civilization's terms, creating a pretext for Qollari-Kheshkai alignment against delta hegemony.

qollari.title: Qollari Highlands
qollari.summary: Passes near Apu-Yana (Black Mountain). Dangerous, rarely used

qollari.title: ecology.domesticates.qollari
qollari.summary: Q'awa [PROP] (Lama glama, llama). Initial ejective uvular /q'/ — the Qollari signature sound. Back low vowel a, open CV final. Plural by reduplication: q'awaq'awa for a drove, q'awakuna with plural suffix.

qollari.title: ecology.encounters.qollari
qollari.summary: Day One — Yungas. You set out before dawn from the cloud-forest tambo where the paved road begins its climb out of the valley. The air is warm and wet, black with the smell of wet moss. Fog drips from tree-fern fronds; Masdevallia orchids cling to the bark; a sparkling violetear hummingbird (Oreotrochilus estella) hums at a red cinchona (Cinchona pubescens) blossom. The arriero warns you to shake your sandals: in thi…

qollari.title: ecology.biome.qollari
qollari.summary: Tropical Andean puna above cloud-forest. Central-Peruvian/Bolivian altiplano.

qollari.title: factions.civ.qollari
qollari.summary: Qollari is "Fragmented (conflictual)" in the typology of magic/06, the second of two civs at the fragmented institutional position and the explicit contrast to Oravan's "Fragmented (tolerant)" archipelago politics. Where Oravan's three-Havrana-lineage disagreement is unorganized and tolerated, the Qollari calendar-keeper dispute is administratively organized, doctrinally explicit, and historically violent — twice in…

qollari.summary: The Calendar Schism is the continental cold war that began when two senior Qollari calendar-keeper lineages produced divergent intercalation calculations for the current cycle, with the result that every date between winter solstice and spring equinox is correct under one lineage's reckoning and void under the other's. Cinchona advance-purchase contracts, mountain-pass corridor-access timings, oath-validity windows,…

qollari.title: magic.system.qollari_willkaqallu
qollari.summary: Etymology: willka (sacred, sun-related) + qallu (throat, passage, from kullku). "Sacred tongue" — the calendrically-gated register of the Qollari.

qollari.title: religion.institution.qollari_calendarists
qollari.summary: A vertical hierarchy that legitimizes and constrains in one move. Trade-corridor access IS calendrical access. The calendar-priesthood functions like the Delphic Oracle as inter-polis arbitrator: opacity is power.

qollari.title: religion.sacred_register.qollari_ejectives
qollari.summary: Qollari magic is calendrical: ejective consonants bind to specific days in a ritual calendar, uvulars are reserved for solstitial rites. The practitioner produces consonants the general population can also produce -- the real monopoly is over which utterances are licit when, enforced by a khipu-plus-calendar knot-record that only the calendarist hierarchy can read.

qollari.title: Qollari Cloud-State
qollari.summary: Ritual formulae are syllabified to match khipu-knot counting patterns. Each syllable corresponds to one knot-position in the record; the formula cannot be spoken faster or slower than the counting tempo. This produces a metronomic cadence distinctive to calendarist speech, audible even when the specific words are not — cliff-wall echoes carry the rhythm across Qollari terraced settlements

qollari.title: Qollari Highlands
qollari.summary: Valley with bizarre echoing acoustics. Used for long-distance communication

oravan.title: ecology.domesticates.oravan
oravan.summary: Naluma [PROP] (Artocarpus altilis, breadfruit). Strict open-syllable CV-CV-CV, low back vowel a with rounded u break, liquid l. No consonant clusters, no closed syllables. A cultivar is a naluma; a grove or lineage-orchard is a nalumarai.

oravan.title: ecology.encounters.oravan
oravan.summary: The first watch of a dry-monsoon morning breaks grey over the anchorage. Before the sun lifts above the palms, the lagoon is a sheet of pewter; you hear the village before you see it — the thump-thump-thump of an outrigger paddle on a hollow hull as a fisherman scares baitfish, the wet slap of a net cast, a rooster on the beach answering another across the channel, and from somewhere in the coconut grove (Cocos nucif…

oravan.title: ecology.biome.oravan
oravan.summary: Volcanic wet-tropical high islands. Maluku/Sulawesi with Hawaiian-style peaks and fringing reefs.

oravan.title: factions.civ.oravan
oravan.summary: Oravan is "Fragmented (tolerant)" in the institutional typology of magic/06, with its three-Havrana-lineage disagreement sitting at the "Diffuse-tolerant" position on the Schism Axis — real disagreement, unorganized, no one publishes. Archipelago geography produces three to seven workshop-lineages per island, each holding its own reading of the cost-efficacy question that underwrites Tavamala consecration. No Wave Co…

oravan.title: magic.system.oravan_tavamala
oravan.summary: Etymology: tava (voice) + mala (craft). "Craft-voice" — the sacred register of the Oravan palace-priestesshood.

oravan.title: religion.tradition.oravan_fire_house
oravan.summary: A local intensification on the Water-Covenant substrate, not a separate tradition family. The Fire-House fuses volcanic fire with the oceanic Water theology to produce something no other descendant of the Water-Covenant has: a dual-aspect divinity whose two media (salt water and volcanic fire) are treated as the same creative-destructive force.

oravan.title: religion.institution.oravan_palace_priestesshood
oravan.summary: The priestess-queen IS the dual aspect of Sea-and-Fire in her body. The palace doesn't need divine sanction; it is the divine manifest in office. Every succession dispute is simultaneously a theological one. This is the civ most vulnerable to schism-as-civil-war.

oravan.title: religion.sacred_register.oravan_reduplication
oravan.summary: Oravan magic exploits vowel-length distinctions and reduplication patterns -- an artisan-priest's invocation distinguishes tama tama (ordinary doubling) from taa-ma taa-ma (ritually-lengthened, tone-governed). The register is tied to craft-acts: you cannot invoke without the associated labor, which is long and witnessed.

oravan.title: religion.conflict.qalibin_refusal_of_oravan_contract
oravan.summary: An Irrah oath-binder refuses to seal an Oravan succession contract on grounds that reduplication-phonology cannot be mapped onto triconsonantal roots. The Oravan court reads this as political insult. The Qalībin's junior Basin-raised apprentice argues for a Tavas-Kaj mediation formula and is told flatly that his training is compromised.

aethelian_basin.title: geography.location.aethelian_basin_substrate
aethelian_basin.summary: The four port zones of the Basin — Ki-Mbuhari, Tavakh-Qarat, Halani-Tamu, Dzong-Tamu — are not founded on bare ground. Each was built on, into, and through the foundations of what was there before, and what was there before was built on the same logic over the foundations of what was there before that. The present file describes the substrate as a stratigraphic and administrative fact, not as an evocation. Basin merc…

aethelian_basin.title: The Unnamed Shrine
aethelian_basin.summary: Your guild IS your identity. You're a khazadari, a warehouse-keeper, a witness-clerk, a glassmaker. Not 'half-Ndjadi, quarter-Oravan'

aethelian_basin.title: geography.location.garamantes_shadow_ruins
aethelian_basin.summary: The four predecessor ruin-sites named below are not haunted; they are bookable. Imajīn caravan-mistresses' factor-correspondence files them under the same operational category as oasis-cisterns and rubāṭ-fort waystations — load-bearing infrastructure whose habitability is bureaucratically maintained. The maintenance is paid out of the Imajīn Caravan Council's dust-tithe pool on a recurrent line-item basis; the foggar…

aethelian_basin.title: factions.trans_civ.basin_merchant_dynasties
aethelian_basin.summary: The Aethelian Basin's four major commercial ports — Tavakh-Qarat at the eastern Irrah-Ndjadi interface, Halani-Tamu at the upriver-cataract gate, Ki-Mbuhari at the central confluence, Dzong-Tamu at the highland-descent shelf — are each currently dominated by a single Basin merchant dynasty whose continental commercial reach exceeds any civ-internal noble lineage's. The four houses are not allied; they compete for one…

aethelian_basin.title: factions.trans_civ.khazadari_internals
aethelian_basin.summary: The Khazadari guild — formally the Northern Khazadari Money-Changer Guild, colloquially "the Khazadari" without modifier when context permits — is the continental clearing-house for cross-civ commercial credit. halkar_straits.title: Oravan Thalassocracy
halkar_straits.summary: The register maintains strictly open (C)V syllable structure throughout. No elision, no vowel reduction, no consonant-final syllables even under physical labor stress. smith_spring.title: religion.sacred_site.smith_spring
smith_spring.summary: An ore-bearing hot spring at the Ngaru-Bon/Irrah frontier. Ngaru-Bon claim it as the site of the First Smith-Ancestor's teaching. Irrah claim it as the dwelling of a ghilu patron of path-finding. Both groups are correct that their tradition is "older here" because the site predates both civilizations' current ethnogenesis.

breath_of_cloud.summary: The Qollari Sky figure. The Sky read as impersonal LAW -- calendrical order whose correct measurement licenses corridor access. Not a person who judges but a pattern that either aligns or does not.

breath_of_cloud.summary: A triennial Kheshkai-Qollari cycle tied to a sky-calendar conjunction both civilizations half-share. halani_tamu.title: magic.scenario.mute_saliqun

coastal_monsoon.title: location.sword_coast
coastal_monsoon.summary: The Sword Coast is a major coastal region of the known world, characterized by rocky cliffs, deep harbors, and rich fishing grounds. It is the most developed region in terms of human civilization and commerce.

scribal_ladder.title: religion.pilgrimage.scribal_ladder
scribal_ladder.summary: The Aethelian's main religious-and-trade axis: Ndjadi habal-copyists undertake a "correction pilgrimage" to Irrah pyramid-necropolises to collate their sacred prefixes against pre-reform attestations. The route strings through Aethelian entrepot copy-houses, crosses Irrah caravan lanes under Qalībin path-finder protection, and returns with necropolis-blessed amulet-bound copies.

scribal_ladder.title: religion.reform.qalibin_naturalist_schism
scribal_ladder.summary: The quietist creed has drifted over two generations into a full naturalist reading: the Five Waters are hydrological categories, not sacred persons; the water-scholar's job is empirical hydrology dressed in ritual register.
